tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Page background: the ground every screen starts from.

tokens.name: sheet-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, notices and menus that sit on sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-sunken
tokens.usage: Code, diffs and terminal output.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only (below 3:1), never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons: 3:1 or more on sheet and sheet-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the logo's sheet, on sheet, sheet-raised and sheet-sunken (14:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and the removed side of a diff, on every sheet token (5.4:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: shift
tokens.usage: The lifted corner: marks what changed. A fill under on-shift text or a graphic beside a word; on light grounds never alone (2:1 on sheet).

tokens.name: shift-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons that point at a change, on every sheet token and on shift-soft (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: shift-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the exact name that changed, under ink or shift-ink.

tokens.name: on-shift
tokens.usage: Text on a shift fill, in both themes (8:1 or more).

tokens.name: jade
tokens.usage: Verified notices, passing checks and added lines, on every sheet token and jade-soft; always with its word or the + sign.

tokens.name: jade-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Verified badge and of added lines.

tokens.name: oxide
tokens.usage: Removed lines and failed checks, on every sheet token and oxide-soft; always with FAIL or the − sign.

tokens.name: oxide-soft
tokens.usage: Background of failed checks and removed lines.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring in ink, 2px away from the control (14:1 on every sheet token).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One statement per page: a hero or a cover.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles and notice summaries in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: OpenAIModel was renamed to OpenAIChatModel, and the old name was removed in 2.0.0.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Checked against the official changelog and the source at v0.7.6.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Versions and paths inside sentences and chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a glyph and its word; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related small items: a label and its version.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding; lines inside a card header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between notices in a list; padding of code blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; between blocks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around a display statement.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Highlights inside code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and notices. Nothing is rounder.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only; cards use a hairline border instead.
